Repo: seo (Avada SEO Suite Shopify app; Firebase Functions in packages/functions/src, React/Polaris v13 in packages/assets/src, Shopify theme app extension in extensions/theme-app-extension; jest 24 from repo root `npx jest <path>`; eslint 6 needs env DISABLE_V8_COMPILE_CACHE=1).

WHY: support ticket SEO-261001-tK9XKD, shop 6940c4.myshopify.com (casapatio.shop). The merchant sells made-to-order products on a dedicated product template (template suffix `cotlin-raw`, e.g. https://casapatio.shop/products/coleccion-missouri). Those products have price 0 and are not purchasable, the storefront shows "Bajo consulta" (price on request). Our app still emits Product/ProductGroup JSON-LD with offers price 0 + availability OutOfStock, and OG meta product:price:amount / product:price:currency / product:availability. Price 0 in structured data is misleading to Google. The merchant wants ONLY the commercial fields (offers: price, availability, and everything nested in offers) removed for products on chosen templates; the page stays indexable; name/description/image/url/brand/sku/gtin/rating stay; products on other templates are unchanged. No such option exists today (checked origin/master).

TASK: add a Product & Collection structured-data setting `excludeOffersTemplates`: a single string of comma-separated product template suffixes (same storage convention as `excludeFields`, see packages/assets/src/helpers/productAndCollection/excludeFields.js for why it is a string and not an array). Default '' so every existing shop renders exactly as before.
- Defaults: add the field to the productAndCollection defaults (packages/functions/src/config/default.js and the assets-side default if one exists - grep where excludeFields defaults live). Make sure the value reaches the storefront the same way excludeFields does (trace how productAndCollection settings are written to the app metafield the liquid reads; if the whole object is serialized nothing more is needed, if fields are whitelisted add it).
- Storefront, theme app extension: in extensions/theme-app-extension/snippets/avada-product-and-collection.liquid compute once per product whether `product.template_suffix` is in the list (trim each entry, ignore empty entries, case-insensitive; a product with blank template_suffix never matches). When it matches, omit the whole "offers" property in EVERY product-page branch (schemaType 'product', the ProductGroup wrapper and per-variant hasVariant offers, AggregateOffer branch) and for that product's item in the collection-page item list. Watch the JSON commas: removing a property must never leave a leading/trailing comma or empty object - the existing excludeFields guards show the comma style to copy. In extensions/theme-app-extension/snippets/avada-seo-social.liquid and avada-seo-social-post.liquid skip product:availability, product:price:amount and product:price:currency for a matching product; og:type and all other tags unchanged. Read the settings object those social snippets already have access to; if they do not receive productAndCollection, pass the list in from the caller the way other settings are passed (grep the render calls) - do not use `{% render %}` output inside JSON-LD (Shopify wraps app snippet renders in HTML comments, which breaks JSON; use capture/assign).
- Server-side renderer: packages/functions/src/config/customGsdLiquid.js (and the legacy social meta strings in packages/functions/src/config/assets.js around the product:price meta) must apply the same rule so both renderers agree.
- Admin UI: packages/assets/src/pages/StructuredV2/Edit/Form/ProductAndCollection.js - a Polaris TextField near the excludeOnProductPage / stock-status options, label like "Hide price and availability for product templates", helpText explaining: enter template suffixes separated by commas (e.g. made-to-order), products using those templates keep their schema but without price/availability. Bound to data.excludeOffersTemplates via handleChangeData. i18n: translations under packages/assets/src/locale/translations/*.json are generated by `yarn update-label`, which needs an API key you do not have; add each new key to the owning JSON the existing StructuredV2.ProductAndCollection.* keys live in (grep) AND a real translation to all 14 translation files (da de en es fr it iw nb nl origin pt-BR sv vi zh-CN), editing only the lines you add, keeping each file's formatting.
- Tests (TDD, failing test first): extend packages/functions/src/config/__tests__/customGsdLiquid.jsonld.test.js (liquidjs render) - matching template drops offers and output is valid JSON-parseable; non-matching template and empty setting keep offers byte-identical to before; whitespace/case in the list; blank template_suffix never matches. Add/extend a guard test (see packages/functions/src/config/__tests__/themeExtensionSchemaGuards.test.js if present on master, else a new test in that dir) that renders the theme extension snippet with a matching product and JSON.parses every ld+json block, and checks the social snippet omits product:price:amount for a matching product and keeps it otherwise. Note liquidjs does not escape `/` in `| json` like Shopify does - do not assert on that.

Rules: touch only files in the contract allow list. Comments say WHY only (a constraint, a Shopify limit), never narrate WHAT; no step numbering, no banners. No secrets, no new dependencies, do not touch .env*, lockfiles, .gitlab-ci.yml, AGENTS.md. HARD RULE for packages/functions: never `await import(...)` a local module (prod ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND) - use require(). Run every verify command yourself and format with `DISABLE_V8_COMPILE_CACHE=1 npx eslint --fix <changed js files>`. Final message: file:line per change, and anything you could not do and why.

contract.goal: Products whose template suffix is listed in productAndCollection.excludeOffersTemplates render Product schema and OG meta without offers/price/availability; all other products and shops with the default empty setting render unchanged

verify.name: eslint
cmd: F=$( { git diff --name-only --diff-filter=AM origin/master -- '*.js'; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- '*.js'; } | sort -u); [ -z "$F" ] || DISABLE_V8_COMPILE_CACHE=1 npx eslint $F
